mapper.insert: insert into post(user_id, title, content) values(#{userId}, #{title}, #{content})
insert into post_view(post_id, ip_address, user_id) values(#{postId}, #{ipAddress}, #{userId})
mapper.update:
update post
title = #{title},
content = #{content},
status = #{status},
where post_id = #{postId}
mapper.delete: delete from post_like where post_id = #{postId} and user_id = #{userId}
delete from post_favorite where post_id = #{postId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select (select count(*) from post_like where post_id = #{postId}) as likeNum, (select count(*) from post_favorite where post_id = #{postId}) as favoriteNum, (select count(*) from post_view where post_id = #{postId}) as viewNum
select img_url from post_img where post_id = #{postId}
select exists(select * from post_like where post_id = #{postId} and user_id = #{userId})
select exists(select * from post_favorite where post_id = #{postId} and user_id = #{userId})
select pt.tag_id, pt.tag_name from post_tag_rel as ptr join post_tag as pt on ptr.tag_id = pt.tag_id where ptr.post_id = #{postId}
select pt.tag_id, pt.tag_name from post_tag as pt left join post_tag_rel as ptr on pt.tag_id = ptr.tag_id group by pt.tag_id, pt.tag_name order by COUNT(ptr.tag_id) desc
SELECT post_id FROM post WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT comment_id FROM post_comment WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT reply_id FROM post_comment_reply WHERE from_user_id = #{userId}
